job_summary: Supervise and control the strategic and business aspects of the company, develop business strategies and plans, oversee operations, build relationships with key partners and stakeholders, and analyze problematic situations to provide solutions.

hard_gates.requirement: Previous experience in the Chief Executive Officer role
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires at least three years of experience as a Chief Executive Officer.

hard_gates.requirement: Minimum experience as a Chief Executive Officer
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly states that at least three years of experience as a Chief Executive Officer are required.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to develop organizational objectives, strategies, and business plans
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires strategic planning and developing business strategies and plans, while O*NET lists developing objectives and strategies as a chief-executive work activity.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to make decisions and solve organizational problems
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires decision making and problem-solving skills, and O*NET identifies Judgment and Decision Making and Complex Problem Solving as transferable skills.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to direct and motivate personnel and coordinate organizational activities
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires leadership skills and oversight of operations, while O*NET lists guiding, directing, and motivating subordinates and coordinating the work of others.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to manage and monitor financial resources and organizational budgets
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires financial management, while O*NET identifies Economics and Accounting knowledge and Management of Financial Resources as relevant to chief executives.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to communicate and maintain relationships with organizational members and external stakeholders
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires communication skills and building trust with partners and stakeholders, while O*NET lists communicating with supervisors, peers, subordinates, and people outside the organization.

soft_profile.candidate_evidence: A strategy case connected market changes to operating priorities and anticipated downstream risks before recommending a direction.
An organizational case separated root causes from symptoms and selected a defensible course under uncertainty.
A leadership exercise aligned competing teams around shared priorities and clarified responsibilities without suppressing dissent.
A budget review identified the main pressures but offered partial monitoring rules and incomplete contingency planning.
A stakeholder simulation relied on generic assurances, missed central concerns, and left external partners unclear about commitments.
